title: Anthropic Adds Up to $500 in Monthly API Credits for Max and Team Plans
summary:
Anthropic is granting its Max and Team subscribers access to the Claude Platform API through the allocation of free monthly usage credits. Users on the Max 5x and Max 20x plans will receive $100 and $200 in credits respectively, while Team plan users will have access to a shared pool of up to $500. These credits are compatible with any model on the platform, including Haiku 5.5, and can be used within custom code or third-party harnesses.

The benefits expansion follows a recent update that halved the price of cache reads for Claude Sonnet 5.5 to $0.10 per million tokens, reducing the cost of agentic workloads by roughly 20%. Some market observers suggest these combined moves give Anthropic a pricing advantage in intelligence-per-unit over OpenAI. These updates occur as some analysts speculate the company has finalized its IPO filings.
